s: Hey everyone, welcome to Word Kitchen, where we cook up new English words with a fun conversation.
Maya, today's topic is one of my favorites.
We're talking about sports and fitness.
We all need some good exercise in our lives, right?
Exercise keeps the body strong and the mind happy.
I started doing a little exercise every morning.
Nothing crazy, just some light exercise at home before work.
My mom always says daily exercise is the best medicine.
And speaking of mornings, do you stretch before you exercise?
I always stretch for five minutes first.
But I know I should stretch.
My friend says if you don't stretch, you can hurt a muscle.
I stretch my legs, my arms, my back.
If you skip the stretch, a tired muscle can get sore the next day.
I tried standing on one leg to test my balance, and wow, my balance needs work!
When you practice balance every day, your balance gets better and better.
So, Maya, are you on any sports team?
A team can make exercise more fun.
I play on a weekend volleyball team!
Our team is small but friendly.
Playing on a team means you never get bored, because the whole team supports you.
Our office has a football team too.
Last weekend our team played a big match.
Oh, tell me about the match!
It was a very close match, and the whole crowd enjoyed the match.
Our team scored first, and we won the match two to one.
Not me, but my friend Sara scored the first goal.
The second goal came from a great pass.
So the final score was two to one.
I love a close score like that.
And after the match, our coach was so happy.
Our coach always tells the team to practice hard.
A good coach makes a big difference.
Our coach plans every practice, and he says if we don't practice, we can't win the match.
We practice free throws, we practice passing, we practice serving.
When the whole team practices together, the team becomes stronger.
Let me ask you, Lena, do you have a goal?
I don't mean a soccer goal.
My goal is to run five kilometers without stopping.
That's my goal for this year.
My goal is to touch my toes.
My goal sounds small, but it needs a lot of stretch work!
Do you do anything for muscle strength?
Strong muscles help you run faster.
My coach says strong leg muscles protect you in a match.
A good coach knows how important muscle care is.
After practice, our coach tells us to stretch every muscle.
Let's repeat our ten words one more time.
Exercise, stretch, muscle, balance, team, match, goal, score, practice, coach.
Let's use them all in one story.
Our team has a great coach.
At practice, we do exercise, we stretch, and we work on balance.
In the match, we score a goal.
The final score makes us smile.
Our goal is to win the next match too!
That little story used every word.
One more time for practice: coach, practice, team, match, goal, score, exercise, muscle, stretch, balance.
Get some exercise, stretch those muscles, and have fun with your team.
See you next time on Word Kitchen!
